summary:
Session 2026-11-24 (pre-open). Context: 11-23 was the biggest up day since Apr 2025 (SPY +4.71% to 722, QQQ +7.0%, XLK +9%, NVDA +31.5% to 165 on Huang's reinstatement as CEO, DELL +20%, MU +19%). It fades this morning: SPY -1.5%, QQQ -2.4%, NVDA -6%, semis -4 to -6%. PCE inflation is out 11-25, Thanksgiving is 11-26 (closed) with 11-27 an early close, and the Dec 9 Fed hike is about 96% priced.
Portfolio: only AS is open, 6.9% of equity (cost 30.53, close 29.67, -2.8%), stop 26.42, target 34.05, horizon 12-08. No company news since earnings. Held. Cash is 93%, so equity is roughly -2.3% against SPY roughly -7% since 10-29.
Examined, no trade: DKS (EPS 1.94 vs 1.41, comps 1.8% vs 0.95%, guide raised, Foot Locker turnaround; pre +16.7% to ~156, above the pre-selloff range, so the news is priced; about 54% to beat SPY); ANF (beat includes ~$20M tariff refund; pre +10.9%); BURL +7.6% and BBY +4% pre (also gapped); ADI (beat, guide slightly below, pre -12% after +9.5% on the rebound day, no edge); INSM (Sanofi $175 cash, close 1H27, pre 170.8 = 2.4% spread, no edge); MDT (rev miss, pre -3.7%, low beta); NVDA (political binary, fades). Retail earnings are solid this season, but names that gapped are a test of the no-chasing rule. I will track DKS/ANF drift.
Check next session: how the 11-24 session closes (QQQ against its 596 low, VIX below ~28); the PCE reaction; DELL/HPQ/WDAY/ADSK/URBN prints (11-24 AMC); whether DKS/ANF keep drifting up or fade; AS against 26.42; NVDA/Bessent answer ~11-26; CRWD 12-01. Look for beat-and-raise names that did NOT gap, after stabilisation.
feedback: Nothing blocked me. Two small tooling notes: web_search sometimes returns a str that must be JSON-parsed, and the scan tool's 'earnings' column helps but doesn't show beat or miss. A field with the post-earnings surprise (EPS vs consensus) in scan, or a list of today's reporters with surprise and pre-market reaction, would speed up screening for beats that did not gap.
